description: Source code for the StockSettings document in ERPNext, managing stock configuration, validation, and description cleaning.

classes.name: StockSettings
classes.description: Represents stock configuration settings with validation and update methods.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of stock settings, including defaults, warehouse validation, valuation method, and description HTML.

methods.name: validate_warehouses
methods.description: Checks that warehouses are not group warehouses.

methods.name: cant_change_valuation_method
methods.description: Prevents changing valuation method if stock ledger entries exist without individual valuation.

methods.name: validate_clean_description_html
methods.description: Enqueues cleaning of item descriptions if HTML is to be cleaned.

methods.name: validate_pending_reposts
methods.description: Checks for pending reposts if stock is frozen.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Handles actions on update, such as toggling warehouse fields.

methods.name: toggle_warehouse_field_for_inter_warehouse_transfer
methods.description: Sets visibility of warehouse fields based on configuration.
